csv_project_name: DB for GAOA Centennial Trail Bridge
csv_scope_of_work: The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) requires a design-build contractor to furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to deliver fully integrated design and construction services for the GAOA Centennial Trail Bridge project near Sturgis, South Dakota. Furnishing labor, equipment, supplies, and materials to design and construct abutments, riprap abutment protection, and to install an appropriately designed steel or timber bridge, designed in accordance with AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications.
